title: CaptionSegment
description: A live or finalized caption segment emitted onto the raw, target, or other-speaker lane.

t0.description: Start timestamp of the spoken segment (Unix milliseconds).

t1.description: End timestamp of the spoken segment (Unix milliseconds).

lane.description: Caption lane: 'raw' (microphone mix), 'target' (Look to Listen), or 'other' (attributed non-target speaker).

face_id.description: Attributed face ID, or null for unattributed raw microphone audio.

confidence.description: Confidence score in [0, 1] for transcription or attribution.

engine.description: Active engine that produced this segment.

segment_id.description: Optional unique identifier so updates can replace in-progress partial captions.

is_final.description: True if this segment has been finalized/merged (e.g. by Neon).

speaker_color.description: Optional speaker hex color corresponding to face_id.

translated_text.description: Optional translated caption text when translate_to is set.

guarded.description: True if the Decision 1 leakage guard evaluated this target-lane segment.
